desc:
Never run out of everyone’s favorite breakfast cereal with three cereals to choose from! Fun, colorful, crunchy breakfast cereal goodness satisfies any time of the day.

Satisfy Your Hunger

Which one will be your kid’s favorite flavor today? Magical yumminess with Lucky Charms? The yummy chocolate flavors from Cookie Crisp? Or, what about those fruity Trix flavors? General Mills cereals feature whole grain as the first ingredient and are rich in multiple essential vitamins and minerals. Whole grains can help lower cholesterol and are rich in dietary fiber, which is essential for digestion and overall good health.

Three Times the Goodness

This cereal variety pack includes three cereals bags: (1) Lucky Charms, (1) Cookie Crisp and (1) Trix.
features: Enjoy breakfast fun and convenience with the General Mills Variety Pack, 38.5 oz – a carefully curated trio of beloved cereals (Lucky Charms, Trix or Cookie Crisp, and Cocoa Puffs) that deliver something for everyone. Each serving stars whole grain as the first ingredient, offering at least 11 g of whole grain per portion. That means you're fueling your morning with sustained energy and essential nutrients. The blend is enhanced with a spectrum of vitamins and minerals, including iron, zinc, calcium, B‑vitamins, and vitamin D, helping support daily wellness goals. Whether you're rushing out the door or enjoying a relaxed weekend breakfast, the variety pack removes indecision and keeps everyone—kids and adults—happy with crunchy, flavorful choices that taste great with milk or on their own as a snack .
ingredients: Trix Ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Modified Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.Cookie Crisp Ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Corn Meal, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Brown Sugar Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Corn Flour, Corn Syrup, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Annatto Extract Color.Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.Trix Ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Rice Flour, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Red 40, Yellow 6, Blue 1 and Other Color Added, Citric Acid, Malic Acid. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
